summary: The root Q-T-F relates to gathering or plucking, especially fruits like grapes. It can refer to the act of harvesting or the time of harvest.
lane: قَطَافٌ ذ and The time of gathering the crop of grapes: (S, Mgh, K:) or the latter has this meaning; and the former is allowable accord. to Ks: (T, TA:) and the latter is also an inf. n., (Mgh,) or may be so, (Ks, T, TA,) meaning the gathering of the crop of grapes: (Mgh:) [or both have this meaning; for] you say, هٰذَا زَمَانُ القَطَافِ and القِطَافِ . (Msb.) See جَدَادٌ .

headwords.def: A bunch of grapes, &c.: pl. قُطُوفٌ: see an ex. voce َلَّلَ. قِطْفٌ i. q. مَقْطُوفٌ. (TA in art. بسط.) See بَسِيطٌ.

and The time of gathering the crop of grapes: (S, Mgh, K:) or the latter has this meaning; and the former is allowable accord. to Ks: (T, TA:) and the latter is also an inf. n., (Mgh,) or may be so, (Ks, T, TA,) meaning the gathering of the crop of grapes: (Mgh:) [or both have this meaning; for] you say, هٰ َا زَمَانُ القَطَافِ and القِطَافِ. (Msb.) See جَدَادٌ.
a coll. gen. n. syn. with قَطَائِفُ, mentioned in the TA voce أُبْلُوجٌ, which see. قَطِيفَةٌ A villous, or nappy, دِثَار [or outer wrapping garment ]. (S, Msb, K.) See also راَحُولَاتٌ.
: see my 1001 Nights, note 23 to chap. viii. See also زَلاَبِيَه. In the TA, art. كنف, it is applied to كُنَافَة.
( vulg. مَقْطَفٌ ) [pl. مَقَاطِف ] A handbasket, made of palm-leaves: so called because originally used in gathering fruit. (See also قُفَّة and زَنْبِيل.)

headword_note: Lane organises by verb form and principal noun, not by every inflected form. A word with no headword entry falls back to the root meaning; nothing is inferred.
